For the longest time, website analytics software was seriously bad. It was hard to understand, time-consuming to use, and worse, it exploited visitor data for big tech to profit. We built Fathom to make analytics easy to use and respectful of privacy.
European analytics
Our entire company is built on putting digital privacy first. Your EU traffic is automatically routed
through European-owned infrastructure

See more of your visitors

anonymous pageview tracking
that doesn't collect or store personal data (we have no use for it). Because of this, Fathom doesn't require annoying cookie notices.

Frequently asked questions
Can I use the same plan for multiple websites?
Yes. Sites on a plan share your monthly pageviews. The larger pageview plans include more sites, and you can add extra site packs from billing if you need them.
How long do you store my analytics data?
Forever, as long as you are a customer. You can access your data all the way back to when you signed up. 7 days, or even 30 days, doesn't show you if your site is trending up or down, which is why we keep your analytics history. Export it before you cancel if you leave.
Why is Fathom better than European-only providers?
Our
data isolation
routes EU visitor traffic through EU infrastructure. Visitors elsewhere are routed through our global infrastructure, so they can connect closer to home. This helps keep analytics fast for visitors around the world.
What happens if I go over my pageview limit?
We never charge for occasional traffic spikes, and we don't shut your account off if you hit your plan limit early. If you stay well over your limit, we'll email you about a larger plan, and you choose whether to upgrade. We send a few friendly reminders and extra time before we pause dashboard and API access, and we keep collecting your data throughout. See our
plan-limits guide
for the details.
Why isn't Fathom free like Google Analytics?
If you aren't paying for a product,
you are the product
. That's why Google Analytics is free, because they make enough money off the personal data their customers give them by using their analytics service. We charge a small and sustainable fee for Fathom because our business model is selling software, not data. Our customers gladly pay for our service because they know their data is safe with us and their visitors' privacy is protected.
Why does digital privacy even matter?
You may think that digital privacy doesn't matter because you have nothing to hide. And that may be true (to some extent), but your data shouldn't be monetised and sold by giant tech companies who are taking your tastes and preferences and selling them to advertisers. By using Fathom, you are making your website
a black hole to big tech
, meaning they cannot track any data about individuals who visit your website.
